longBusinessSummary: Mattel, Inc. is a toy and family entertainment company headquartered in El Segundo, California. Its owned brands include Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, UNO, Matchbox, Polly Pocket and Masters of the Universe. Beyond toys, Mattel develops films and television series around its brands and runs a digital games business, including the mobile developer Mattel163, fully owned since the first quarter of 2026.
